title: Chapter 366
text:
"These Dragon Guards are on the same side as Horlaide. Their target is also the Silvers!" Goa said anxiously in the communication channel.

Cerleni's expression was terrible. If they surrendered, the guards would still make a deal with Horlaide, and the Silvers would still be taken away and handed over to the buyer, which meant that the rescue mission would fail. If they did not surrender, they would not be able to afford the price of so many casualties. He was in a dilemma. However, the cannon fire did not stop, and he did not have time to think.

"As long as we control the Dragon Guards, the problem will be solved," Han Xiao said with a deep voice. He was thinking the same thing as everyone else.

However, Cerleni yelled, "Are you crazy? Killing the Dragon Guards is the biggest crime here! " In this territory, the severity of causing trouble and assaulting the police were worlds apart. With that Beyond Grade A boss in charge, even though most of these Dragon Guards were ordinary people, they could still do whatever they wanted to the brutes and wanted criminals.

"I didn't kill anyone. We have an Ice Mage here who can freeze their aircraft."

Before Cerleni could say anything, Goa rushed to the dock and said, "I'm going to do it!"

Goa moved quickly. Her eyes suddenly turned snow-white, and a magic mark appeared on her forehead. She chanted a spell, and the magic ring on her snow-white finger started to shine. The free magic elements gathered and combined, repaired, and formed under the effects of the spell, magic power, secret circle, and magic artifact. The magic language was deconstructed and then reorganized into natural laws, creating changes to reality.

A large amount of low-temperature water vapor suddenly appeared in the air. White frost spread out from under Goa's feet all the way to the aircraft. Five icicles suddenly rose from the ground and grabbed the aircraft like claws. The magic low temperature turned the aircraft off. The aircraft flew forward due to inertia, and the icicles extended, turning them into ice sculptures very quickly. The icicles became a bridge connecting the aircraft and the ground, freezing the five aircraft in midair.

Goa was a Grade B Mage, so her control was very strong. Although she froze the aircraft, it did not cause any damage.

The pilot of the aircraft hurriedly used the control panel. "All systems are temporarily down. Restarting. Hiss … so cold!"

Theon was furious. "How dare they fight back! Report to the top and ask for backup. Don't let them escape! "

Since the deed had already been done, the mercenaries could only seize the opportunity to escape. Everyone gathered together and boarded their respective spaceships. Han Xiao sat in the upper ring's car. The pilots who did not participate in the battle at the beginning had already started the spaceship. As soon as everyone boarded, the spaceship slowly lifted off and flew away from Floating Dragon Island.

The transformed stalker of the Blades team had already confirmed that there was the scent of the Silvers in the box. He opened the box, and as expected, there were fifteen Silvers inside. They huddled together in the corner of the box, looking terrified.

They could not see what was happening outside. The explosions along the way scared them to death. As soon as the box was opened, the Silver screamed in fear. The antennae on its head shook so much that it looked very cute. It made Han Xiao have the urge to pull them out.

"You're safe. We're mercenaries hired by your companions. We're here to rescue you." Goa casually cast a reassuring spell to calm the emotions of the Silvers. She told the team members to take out translators and put them on the Silvers so that they could communicate with each other.

Finally, the group of Silvers calmed down. Goa contacted the employer, and the two groups of Silvers met. Their eyes were filled with tears, and their conversation could be summarized as, "Buddy, I missed you so much."

The employer counted and said with surprise, "Why are there only fifteen people? Where did the other two companions go?"

"Two people are missing?" Goa was shocked. If two people were missing, the reward for this trip might be reduced.

The group of Silvers who were rescued had a sad expression and replied, "The two of them were thrown into space by scavengers. Their bodies are cold."

Hearing that, Goa heaved a sigh of relief and said, "Thank goodness, they're just dead."

Han Xiao immediately raised his eyebrows.

"There's indeed no good among the mercenaries. How black-hearted."

After a moment of silence, the employer said, "You've completed your mission very well. Please send our companions back. I'll pay you according to the agreement."

After working so hard, they could finally earn their reward. Every mercenary's face was filled with joy.

Thinking that he was about to get the last two advanced knowledges of compression technology, Han Xiao was secretly excited.

Boom!

Suddenly, the spaceship shook violently, and they almost fell. The pilot hurriedly said, "Sh * t, Floating Dragon Island sent spaceships to chase after us!"

Everyone's expression changed. They went to the porthole and looked behind the spaceship. At this time, the three mercenary groups' spaceships had already left Floating Dragon Island's artificial ecological shield and entered the space environment, gradually leaving the floating island.

However, a few Floating Dragon Island spaceships followed them out and fired at their spaceship. Lasers hit the shield one after another, making their spaceship tremble.

Theon exaggerated the matter and reported it to the upper echelons. He thought that the mercenaries attacked the guards maliciously and broke the rules, so Floating Dragon Island's spaceship fleet chased after them and wanted to blow them up in space.

On the dock of the floating island, a group of brutes looked at this chase in space. Floating Dragon wanted to make an example out of them, saying that anyone who broke the rules would have to pay the price.

"Didn't we just freeze their spaceships? Is there a need to make such a big commotion?" Porter was furious.

"Start the hyperdrive engine quickly. As long as we enter the hyperdrive state, they won't be able to catch up to us," Goa ordered loudly.

The mercenary piloting the spaceship tried to dodge as much as possible. Cracks appeared on the shield, but at the same time, the spaceship also sped up. The voice of the artificial intelligence system echoed in the spaceship.

"Activating hyperdrive engine, power output 2% … 7% … 14% … 83%. Power output met. Warming up before hyperdrive."

The spaceship gradually shook off the enemies, and the space outside the window blurred. It was about to enter the hyperdrive.

However, something unexpected happened. Just one second before entering the hyperdrive, the mercenary group's spaceship froze without any warning. All the kinetic energy and inertia seemed to have disappeared into thin air. None of the mercenaries even felt the slightest vibration.

Suddenly, the air inside the spaceship started to buzz. It was as if every inch of air had become a vocal cord, forming a terrifying sound wave that almost broke their eardrums. Not only did they shake, they even hit the ground.

"Attacking my cute subordinates in my home, do you think you can just walk away so easily?"

The few spaceships of the mercenary group seemed to have been grabbed by an invisible hand and flew back the way they came. All the propulsion devices stopped working. No matter how hard the pilots tried to control the spaceships, it was all in vain.

The players were shocked. They did not know what had happened. The Silvers were also confused. They were shocked. The hope of going home was right in front of them. They had clearly shaken off the enemy's spaceships, so why were they suddenly controlled?

The mercenaries on the side had a drastic change in expression.

"He's here …" Cerleni's face was pale.

Goa was shocked and said, "We just made some noise. How did we attract the attention of the ruler of Floating Dragon Island?"

"Maybe she's just too bored …" Han Xiao was extremely annoyed. He did not expect the ruler of Floating Dragon Island to personally interfere in this kind of situation. It was like two ants fighting on the street. How bored would one be to stop and interfere?

They were so close to completing the mission, but an unexpected factor suddenly appeared. Furthermore, it was an existence that they could not compete with at the current stage. He was so unlucky. The Goddess of Luck also f * cking rejected his hug.

Han Technician glared at Herlous, who was beside him, with resentment.

What the f * ck? He was clearly bringing along a main character. How could he be so unlucky? Had this main character expired? Was it too late to return it now?!

The spaceships struggled but to no avail. They were pulled back to the floating island dock by an invisible force field. The hatch was torn open by the force field, and the mercenaries walked out. In front of such power, resistance was meaningless.

Han Xiao did not have any good ideas at the moment, so he could only take one step at a time.

At this time, the dock was full of people, stretching their necks to watch the show. The ruler of Floating Dragon Island was floating in midair. When the people on the ground raised their heads, their faces were filled with respect. This was respect and worship for absolute power.

The throne made of Void Dragon bones was floating in midair. A tall and graceful woman was leaning on the throne with one leg crossed over the other. One of her hands was casually hanging on the armrest of the chair, and the other hand was supporting her chin. She looked down at everyone like a legendary big boss. Her soft black hair was at least two meters long. She was wearing a thin black dress with a wide open collar. However, there was no cleavage. She was flat-chested.

Her skirt was split very high, revealing two snow-white long legs. They overlapped each other like two white snakes. The black skirt and the white legs created an extremely strong visual contrast, wantonly emitting an aura of seduction. Her figure was alluring and seductive, but her face could not be considered beautiful. However, she was very charming, without any signs of age. Her eyes were lively, and there were symmetrical complicated black marks at the corners of her eyes. The patterns were like black thorns, just like eyeshadow. At this time, she was looking at everyone with a curious face.

This woman had a series of titles, such as' Lord of Floating Dragon ',' Land Ripper ',' Absolute Power ', and so on. She was the creator and ruler of Floating Dragon Island — [Dragon Emperor] Ames.
